provenance.source: Backend-generated: POST /api/v1/trades/evaluate (FastAPI TestClient, in-process) over the repo's disposable seeded_league test fixture, SQLite in memory; synthetic players only.
provenance.generator: scratch script outside Git (W2.5); no server, no owner or preview data.
provenance.trim: top-level financial_analysis removed from every response (the evaluator page does not read it from the evaluate response; ~20 KB each). Nothing else edited.

scenarios.partial: deal includes an unmodelled player and a player with no contract: contract and assets unscored, confidence low
scenarios.no_distribution: pick-only deal (no player moves): the producer returns its no-distribution uncertainty block
scenarios.insufficient_data: explicit all-zero weights: composite_utility null although a simulation distribution exists
scenarios.suppressed_illegal: salary-matching failure with a complete payroll: HTTP 200, decision_status suppressed_illegal, uncertainty {}
scenarios.http_422: unprocessable request: the backend error envelope (non-2xx)

assets.payroll_basis: sum of the moved players' salaries for the cap league year
assets.payroll_scored_note: reported, not scored — the contract component prices salary against impact, and scoring the raw delta here as well made the two components 0.837 correlated over 168 evaluations
assets.pick_reference: 1.0 unit = the empirical value of slot 15, worth 8.0 composite points — the value a pick has always carried here, now applied per pick rather than per count
assets.unavailable: No draft pick in this deal could be priced, so there is no draft capital to score. The roster-spot term alone spans four points and cannot express asset value, so scoring it would put a near-constant in the composite.

contract.method: cap-dollar-per-impact heuristic (no historical salary model data)

needs_not_addressable.point_of_attack_defense: no player skill claims to address this: on-ball defence cannot be measured from box-score data, and a steals-based proxy rates ball-dominant guards above the defenders who actually guard them

legality_verification.note: How much of the implemented CBA check reached a verdict for this team. Reported, never scored: measured over 482 evaluations it runs 0.063 ± 0.071 with a ceiling of 0.143, and what moves it is which contract fields the configured provider supplies — a property of the dataset, not of the deal. Scoring it would add a near-constant offset.

risk.method: minutes-weighted availability of the arriving package minus the departing one, on [-1, 1], mapped affinely to 0..100

roster_shape.basis: Roster composition, from R4-3's deterministic roles and R5.5's rotation allocator. It is not lineup data: nothing here knows who is on the floor together, and no claim about on-court synergy is made.

lineup_fit.also: two- and three-man groups do have usable samples, but a trade prices combinations that have never played together, and this repository holds no held-out target against which a synergy model could be validated
lineup_fit.reason: five-man lineup samples are too small to estimate a lineup effect — the median group among the top 2,000 by minutes played 20.2 minutes in 2024-25, which carries a standard error of about 16 net-rating points per 100 possessions against a league team spread of roughly ±10
